privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What Budget Agent keeps about you, why, where and for how long, and how you take it or delete it.

data.title: What we keep
data.body:
Your account: name, email address, a hash of your password, language, currency and budget; your plan and any plan given to you, with the reason; and, if you turn on two-factor sign-in, its encrypted key and the hashes of your recovery codes.

What you add: receipts and what is read from them — shop, date, items, amounts, categories — the trips, goals, rules and household you set up; and the income you enter and the balance you start from, which no household member sees. Receipt photos and forwarded e-receipts are kept as files.

If you write to us through the contact form on the Help page, your address and message are mailed to us to answer you; the service itself does not keep them.

why.title: Why
why.body:
Only to provide the service you signed up for: reading receipts, keeping your budget and sending letters about your account (confirming your address, resetting your password). Request logs and IP addresses are kept to keep the service secure and working. Nothing is sold, shared for advertising or used for anything else.

When you are signed in, the service also records what you do in it — signing up, confirming your address, signing in, using it on a day, adding a receipt, exporting — with the time and nothing more, to run and support the service and to know whether it is used. It never records what your receipts say. Visits to the public pages are only counted, by page and the site you came from, with nothing that could say who you are.

where.title: Where, and who processes it
where.body: Everything is stored and processed on Google Cloud in the USA (region us-central1): the server, the database, file storage, mail and the AI model that reads receipt photos (Vertex AI Gemini, which does not train on your data). Google processes it for us under its Cloud Data Processing Addendum; the transfer to the USA rests on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and standard contractual clauses.

keep.title: How long
keep.body: Receipt photos and forwarded files: 90 days, then storage deletes them — the figures read from them stay. Export files: 7 days. Request logs: 30 days. Everything else: until you delete your account; database backups hold it for at most 7 more days. A message through the contact form stays in our mailbox as long as answering it needs. The record of what you do in the service: 12 months. What an administrator did on your account (for example, granting a plan or sending you a link) is logged; when you delete your account, the log no longer says whose it was.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: In Settings you can download everything held about you in one archive, and delete your account with all of it. You can correct any receipt and any profile field at any time. Under the GDPR you may also object to processing or complain to your data protection authority.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: Budget Agent is run by Bohdan Razhyk, a sole trader in Poland, who decides how your data is used (the controller). Write to bohdan.razhyk.support@gmail.com, or through the form on the Help page, about anything in this policy.

storage.title: Cookies and what is kept on your device
storage.body:
Budget Agent sets no cookies and loads nothing from other websites: no trackers, no advertising, no third-party fonts or widgets.

Your browser keeps only what the service needs to work, or what you chose: your sign-in session and account details (so a reload does not sign you out), the theme and language you picked, the period and order you set for the receipts list, hints you closed, and the app's own files so it opens quickly and offline. Because each is strictly needed or set by you, no consent is asked for them. Signing out removes the session; clearing the site's data in your browser removes all of it.

If we ever add something that needs your consent, we will ask before it runs.

ai.title: Reading receipts with AI
ai.body: Receipt photos and names are read and categorised by an AI model. It only turns what is printed into figures you can check and correct; it makes no decision about you with legal or similarly significant effects.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: The rules of using Budget Agent. By opening an account you agree to them and to the privacy policy.

service.title: The service
service.body: Budget Agent reads receipts you photograph or forward and keeps your budget. It is a diploma project, offered free of charge, as it is: it can make mistakes reading a receipt, and every figure can be corrected by you. It is not financial, tax or legal advice.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Use an email address you read and keep your password to yourself. One account is one person. You are responsible for what is done with your account.

content.title: What you upload
content.body: Your receipts and data stay yours. Upload only what you have the right to, and nothing unlawful. We process it only to provide the service, as the privacy policy describes.

use.title: Fair use
use.body: Do not try to break, overload or get round the limits of the service, or to reach other users' data. Accounts that do may be suspended.

end.title: Changes and ending
end.body: You can delete your account at any time from Profile. If these terms change in substance, you will be asked to accept the new version. The service may change or stop; we will try to tell you in time to download your data.

law.title: Law and consumer rights
law.body: These terms are governed by Polish law. Nothing in them limits the rights you have as a consumer under the law of the country where you live.
